title: Go Set a Watchman

vibeProfile.oneLine: An adult Scout comes home and sees her father, and her country, anew.

summary: An adult Scout returns from New York to her Alabama hometown and is forced to see her revered father Atticus, and her whole idea of home, in a harsher, more troubling light. Written before To Kill a Mockingbird but published only in 2015, it reads as a rougher, more disillusioned companion to the classic, wrestling openly with the racism the earlier book softened. Uneven but fascinating, it complicates one of literature's most beloved fathers.
whyReadIt: The controversial early draft that recasts Atticus, and America's idea of him. Rough, but a fascinating shadow of Mockingbird.

funFacts.text: Written first but published 55 years after Mockingbird, its release stirred debate about how it came to light.
